595: ## 8. 分阶段实施和验收
596: 
597: ### B0：冻结输入和ABI
598: 
599: 输出一份同日记录，包含：
600: 
601: - CP `app.bin`、`app.map`、`sdkconfig.h` SHA256。
602: - 实际 controller archive名称。
603: - AP/CP toolchain下 descriptor `sizeof/offsetof`。
604: - vendor INIT/DEINIT逐字节 trace。
605: - CP Event/ACL pointer实际分布。
606: - controller LE ACL最大长度和数量。
607: - AP SRAM pool地址被 CP实际读取成功的证明。
608: 
609: 这些未完成前不注册 NuttX Host。
610: 
611: ### B1：raw BT logical transport
612: 
613: 实现 `0x13/0x43`、raw frame、UART索引修复、BT TX/RX queue和统计。由于正式 CP
614: 没有任意 BT descriptor echo入口，不执行“无 HCI语义双向 loopback”：
615: 
616: - AP -> CP只对定义明确的 vendor INIT/HCI command做10,000次 descriptor ACK压力。
617: - CP -> AP通过真实 vendor event和Command Complete验证。
618: - 若要任意 descriptor echo，必须使用独立测试CP固件，不能写成“不修改CP”的正式门禁。
619: 
620: ### B2：完整raw HCI初始化
621: 
622: 暂不注册Host，测试入口按当前 `hci_initialize()` 顺序发送并检查真实status：
623: 
624: 1. vendor INIT。
625: 2. HCI Reset。
626: 3. Read Local Supported Features。
627: 4. Read Local Version Information。
628: 5. Read BD_ADDR。
629: 6. LE Read Local Supported Features。
630: 7. LE Read Buffer Size。
631: 8. Set Event Mask。
632: 9. LE Set Event Mask。
633: 10. Host Buffer Size。
634: 11. Set Controller To Host Flow Control。
635: 12. 若controller报告BR/EDR能力，再测 Read Buffer Size和LE Write Host Supported。
636: 13. 收到ACL后验证 Host Number Of Completed Packets。
637: 
638: 每条命令记录 opcode、transport ACK、FREE、Command Complete/Status和status；不得用
639: ACK代替HCI成功。
640: 
641: ### B3：注册NuttX Host
642: 
643: - `open()` 完成唯一 vendor INIT握手。
644: - Host完整初始化无timeout。
645: - `ifconfig` 可看到 `bnep0`。
646: - 注册结束时默认 advertising已经成功。
647: - `System.map` 包含 `bk7258_bt_*`、`bt_netdev_register`、`bt_initialize`。
648: 
649: ### B4：advertising和scan
650: 
651: 实板NSH基线：
652: 
653: ```sh
654: bt bnep0 info
655: bt bnep0 features le
656: bt bnep0 advertise stop
657: bt bnep0 advertise start
658: bt bnep0 scan start -d
659: bt bnep0 scan get
660: bt bnep0 scan stop
661: ```
662: 
663: 手机使用 nRF Connect或等价工具确认 `VelaSights` 可发现。advertising stop/start
664: 重复100次；scan start/get/stop重复100次，前后 heap和pool计数回到基线。
665: 
666: ### B5：连接和GATT fixture
667: 
668: 内置 `bt_services.c` 只有GAP name/appearance read，不足以验收write和notification。
669: 在 board目录增加最小测试service，具备：
670: 
671: - 一个 read/write characteristic。
672: - 一个 notify characteristic。
673: - CCC descriptor。
674: - NSH命令触发一次或周期 notification。
675: 
676: 手机侧完成连接、service discovery、read、write、订阅CCC、notification、disconnect
677: 和reconnect。OpenVela作为client时使用：
678: 
679: ```sh
680: bt bnep0 gatt connect <addr> public
681: bt bnep0 gatt characteristic <addr> public
682: bt bnep0 gatt read <addr> public <handle>
683: bt bnep0 gatt write <addr> public <handle> <byte> [byte...]
684: bt bnep0 gatt disconnect <addr> public
685: ```
686: 
687: 地址类型按scan结果改为 `random`。验收同时检查双向ACL flow control和四类完成统计。
688: 
689: ### B6：稳定性、恢复和共存
690: 
691: - advertising/单连接运行72小时。
692: - connect/disconnect 1,000次。
693: - notification持续压力，queue/pool无净增长。
694: - Wi-Fi DHCP/TCP压力下 BLE不异常断开。
695: - BLE压力下 heartbeat、PWC、Mailbox UART无timeout。
696: - malformed/unknown/duplicate FREE全部拒绝且不破坏allocator。
697: - 无in-flight时 DEINIT/INIT 100次。
698: - 整机复位100次均重新出现 `bnep0` 和 advertising。
699: 
700: ### B7：SMP兼容复核
701: 
702: 不在本轮启用CPU2，但提交前检查：
703: 
704: - 无依赖 `up_cpu_index()==0` 才正确的未保护全局状态。
705: - ISR只做descriptor copy，worker/Host调用不在ISR。
706: - queue和ownership table同步在未来SMP下成立。
707: - 若未来启用 Host线程 affinity，配置中的 core编号按 NuttX逻辑CPU而非物理CPU解释。

780: ## 10. 诊断和安全门禁
781: 
782: 每类统计至少包含：
783: 
784: ```text
785: tx_enqueue, tx_ack, tx_timeout, tx_free, tx_free_unknown,
786: rx_event, rx_acl, rx_sco_rejected, rx_bad_pointer, rx_bad_length,
787: rx_queue_full, host_receive_error, vendor_timeout, recovery_count,
788: controller_completed, host_completed
789: ```
790: 
791: 故障定位顺序：
792: 
793: 1. 确认最终 CP配置、controller archive和CP `bt_ipc_core` hash。
794: 2. 确认 Mailbox link READY，BT TX `0x13`、RX `0x43` 已注册。
795: 3. 确认 vendor INIT event `fe 03 01 00 00` 的语义和对应 FREE。
796: 4. 区分 descriptor ACK、FREE和HCI Complete。
797: 5. 检查传给NuttX的数据不含H4 byte，Event从event code开始、ACL从handle开始。
798: 6. 检查 `BLUETOOTH_MAX_FRAMELEN`、CP pointer窗口和little-endian length。
799: 7. 检查 Command、ACL、FREE队列保留容量和ownership状态。
800: 8. 检查 Host Number Of Completed Packets与controller Number Of Completed Packets。
801: 
802: 安全规则：
803: 
804: - unknown FREE绝不直接free。
805: - 完全非法 CP pointer绝不原样FREE给CP。
806: - 可信CP wrapper即使SCO策略拒绝，也要安全排队FREE并记录拒绝。
807: - 任何 pointer加法先检查overflow。
808: - packed multi-byte字段只通过 `memcpy`/endian helper读取。
809: - 当前 `dmb sy` 只保证顺序；如果将来任一侧启用cache或把pool移到PSRAM，必须补
810:   clean/invalidate和明确的内存属性验证。
811: 
812: ## 11. 延后项和协议演进
813: 
814: ### 11.1 bond持久化
815: 
816: 当前 NuttX `bt_keys.c` 只使用静态RAM key pool；contest也没有可用的CP Flash proxy
817: bond backend。因此本轮可测试运行期 pairing/encryption，但不能把“重启后bond恢复”
818: 列为完成条件。后续必须先实现：
819: 
820: - CP Flash proxy channel和访问控制。
821: - key序列化版本、完整性和机密性。
822: - 掉电安全、磨损控制和加载/保存接口。
823: 
824: ### 11.2 独立复位恢复
825: 
826: 若要求 AP reset而CP继续运行，必须允许修改CP协议，至少增加：
827: 
828: - AP/CP BT generation或epoch。
829: - CP在AP generation变化时停止访问旧 AP pointer并重置BT IPC/controller。
830: - 显式 reset-ready handshake。
831: - 双方确认后统一回收旧pool。
832: 
833: 没有上述闭环时，AP reset会丢失 ownership table，CP仍可能访问同一 SRAM地址；
834: 任何“本地清表后继续”的实现都有 use-after-free/串包风险。
835: 
836: ### 11.3 OpenVela Bluetooth Framework
837: 
838: 产品若需要 Framework/SAL、QuickApp或NDK，另立方案同步对应仓库、服务进程、IPC、
839: 权限和Framework级测试；不得把本计划的 NuttX native Host验收冒充Framework完成。
840: 
841: ## 12. 完成定义
842: 
843: 满足以下条件才算完成本轮 BK7258 OpenVela Bluetooth移植：

845: - 当前CP继续运行唯一 BLE controller，OpenVela运行唯一Host。

591: ### 7.2 Make/CMake
592: 
593: Chip `CMakeLists.txt`：
594: 
595: ```cmake
596: if(CONFIG_BK7258_BLUETOOTH)
597:   list(APPEND SRCS bk7258_bt_transport.c bk7258_bt_driver.c)
598: endif()
599: ```
600: 
601: `Make.defs` 使用等价的 `ifeq ($(CONFIG_BK7258_BLUETOOTH),y)`。board GATT fixture
602: 同样在 `src/CMakeLists.txt` 和 `src/Makefile` 条件加入。修改 Kconfig/defconfig后先
603: 执行 CMake distclean。
604: 
605: 增加 `CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RAW_SELFTEST`，依赖 `BK7258_BLUETOOTH`，默认关闭。启用时
606: board bring-up只初始化BT transport并运行第B1/B2阶段的开机自检，打印逐opcode结果，
607: 随后保持transport在诊断态，不调用 `bt_driver_register()`。这样raw测试和正式Host
608: 不会同时消费同一Event，也不需要在apps或CP中增加临时命令。正式功能构建必须关闭

611: ## 8. 分阶段实施和验收
612: 
613: ### B0：冻结输入和ABI
614: 
615: 输出一份同日记录，包含：
616: 
617: - CP `app.bin`、`app.map`、`sdkconfig.h` SHA256。
618: - 实际 controller archive名称。
619: - AP/CP toolchain下 descriptor `sizeof/offsetof`。
620: - vendor INIT/DEINIT逐字节 trace。
621: - CP Event/ACL pointer实际分布。
622: - controller LE ACL最大长度和数量。
623: - AP SRAM pool地址被 CP实际读取成功的证明。
624: 
625: 这些未完成前不注册 NuttX Host。
626: 
627: ### B1：raw BT logical transport
628: 
629: 启用 `CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RAW_SELFTEST=y`，实现 `0x13/0x43`、raw frame、UART索引
630: 修复、BT TX/RX queue和统计。由于正式 CP
631: 没有任意 BT descriptor echo入口，不执行“无 HCI语义双向 loopback”：
632: 
633: - AP -> CP对定义明确的 vendor INIT/HCI command做10,000次顺序事务；每次都先回收
634:   response wrapper和command wrapper，再开始下一次。
635: - CP -> AP通过真实 vendor event和Command Complete验证。
636: - 若要任意 descriptor echo，必须使用独立测试CP固件，不能写成“不修改CP”的正式门禁。
637: 
638: ### B2：完整raw HCI初始化
639: 
640: 继续使用raw selftest构建且不注册Host，按当前 `hci_initialize()` 顺序发送并检查
641: 真实status：
642: 
643: 1. vendor INIT。
644: 2. HCI Reset。
645: 3. Read Local Supported Features。
646: 4. Read Local Version Information。
647: 5. Read BD_ADDR。
648: 6. LE Read Local Supported Features。
649: 7. LE Read Buffer Size。
650: 8. Set Event Mask。
651: 9. LE Set Event Mask。
652: 10. Host Buffer Size。
653: 11. Set Controller To Host Flow Control。
654: 12. 若controller报告BR/EDR能力，再测 Read Buffer Size和LE Write Host Supported。
655: 
656: 每条命令记录 opcode、transport ACK、FREE、Command Complete/Status和status；不得用
657: ACK代替HCI成功。B2通过后关闭 `CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RAW_SELFTEST`、执行distclean，
658: 再进入B3正式Host构建。
659: 
660: ### B3：注册NuttX Host
661: 
662: - `open()` 完成唯一 vendor INIT握手。
663: - Host完整初始化无timeout。
664: - `ifconfig` 可看到 `bnep0`。
665: - 注册结束时默认 advertising已经成功。
666: - `System.map` 包含 `bk7258_bt_*`、`bt_netdev_register`、`bt_initialize`。
667: 
668: ### B4：advertising和scan
669: 
670: 实板NSH基线：

673: bt bnep0 info
674: bt bnep0 features le
675: bt bnep0 advertise stop

677: bt bnep0 scan start -d
678: bt bnep0 scan get
679: bt bnep0 scan stop
680: ```
681: 
682: 手机使用 nRF Connect或等价工具确认 `VelaSights` 可发现。advertising stop/start
683: 重复100次；scan start/get/stop重复100次，前后 heap和pool计数回到基线。
684:

### Physical descriptor bytes

`bk7258_mbox_send()` does not copy the 16-byte message into the hardware FIFO. It sends a two-word physical envelope:

```c
wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
wire[1] = sizeof(*message);       /* 16 */
bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
```

The formal implementation is at:

`.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:223-248`

and ultimately stages the words into:

```c
TDATA0 = data[0];
TDATA1 = data[1];
TID    = destination;
```

at:

`.../bk7258_mbox0.c:120-127`.

For AP → CP Bluetooth:

```text
physical data[0] = AP address of 16-byte Bluetooth descriptor
physical data[1] = 0x00000010
destination      = 0 / CPU0
```

`/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:391-446`

Important properties:

- `result == -EREMOTEIO` means the peer returned `BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL`.

- sequence matches

### Correct Bluetooth RX callback behavior

For a received Bluetooth packet:

- Copy or extract the HCI packet type and pointer immediately.
- Enqueue the pointer to a worker queue.
- Return `OK` only after the queue entry is safely recorded.
- Return `-EAGAIN` if the queue is full, so the formal mailbox retains/defer-retries the command instead of acknowledging and losing ownership.
- Do not free the pointer from the ISR unless the packet is definitively rejected.
- Do not block or allocate large buffers in the callback.

This differs from the vendor implementation, which pushes a small `{type, pointer}` record into a queue from its mailbox RX callback.

`/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:56-146`.

# 8. Memory, pointer, cache, and lifetime constraints

## 8.1 Pointer width

The vendor wire structure carries:

```c
uint32_t hdr_ptr;
```

at:

`.../bt_ipc_core.h:58-72`.

The vendor code explicitly casts allocated pointers to 32-bit:

```c
msg.hdr_ptr = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cmd_hdr;
```

and equivalent event/ACL/SCO paths:

- AP: `.../ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:177-295`
- CP: `.../cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:180-298`

Therefore:

- Both cores must use a shared 32-bit address map.
- The pointer must be visible and dereferenceable by the receiving core.
- Do not use a pointer to private TCM, inaccessible cache alias, stack, or a region not mapped by the peer.
- Do not assume a 64-bit pointer can be represented.
- The descriptor envelope pointer and the HCI payload pointer are separate pointers.

## 8.2 Physical descriptor memory

The formal transport places active and ACK messages in aligned static storage:

- active message aligned to 32 bytes: `.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:51-61`
- ACK message aligned to 32 bytes: `.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:63-68`
- recovery reset/probe messages aligned to 32 bytes: `.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:70-78`

The physical sender publishes a pointer to that storage rather than copying to a hardware register:

`.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:223-234`.

The receiver copies the 16-byte descriptor before invoking higher-level logic:

`.../bk7258_mbox0.c:246-259`.

Consequently, the formal transport’s `message` pointer passed to an RX callback is a local copied descriptor and is not the original shared slot. It is only valid during callback execution.

## 8.3 HCI payload lifetime

The HCI data itself is not copied into the mailbox descriptor. Only its address is carried.

AP allocation examples:

- commands: `.../ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:201-223`
- events: `.../ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:225-247`
- ACL: `.../ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:249-271`
- SCO: `.../ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:273-295`

CP allocation examples:

- vendor commands/events: `.../cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:180-250`
- ACL/SCO: `.../cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:252-298`

Ownership rules:

- Sender allocates HCI body.
- Receiver consumes it from the pointer.
- Receiver eventually sends `HCI_FREE_PKT` back to the allocating core.
- Allocating core frees the pointer after receiving `HCI_FREE_PKT`.

For CP-originated events/ACL:

- CP allocates.
- AP consumes.
- AP sends `HCI_FREE_PKT`.
- CP frees at `.../cp/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:464-469`.

For AP-originated commands:

- AP allocates.
- CP consumes.
- CP sends `HCI_FREE_PKT`.
- AP frees at `.../ap/components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c:441-446`.

## 8.4 Cache and barriers

The formal mailbox uses a system data barrier before publishing:

- AP formal send: `.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:229-233`
- AP physical receive before copying: `.../bk7258_mbox0.c:254-255`

The vendor CP mailbox adapter uses cache clean before publishing a stable slot:

`.../cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:423-430`.

The vendor generic IPC code uses cache flush and `__DMB()` when copying swap-region data:

`.../cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c:160-169`, `:204-213`, and `:277-284`.

For the Bluetooth pointer transport, the implementation must ensure:

1. HCI body contents are visible before publishing its pointer.
2. The 16-byte descriptor is visible before publishing its envelope pointer.
3. The receiver invalidates/flushes as required by the actual cache configuration before dereferencing the cross-core HCI pointer.
4. The HCI body remains allocated until the receiver has finished using it and returned `HCI_FREE_PKT`.

The existing vendor BT code does not show explicit cache maintenance around the HCI heap buffers. It relies on the underlying mailbox/memory configuration. That assumption must be verified for the OpenVela AP heap and the Armino CP heap.

## Field requirements

### `head_reserve`

`head_reserve` is the number of bytes reserved before `data` for transport framing.

For H:4 UART:

```c
.head_reserve = H4_HEADER_SIZE
```

where:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_uart.h:51`

```c
#define H4_HEADER_SIZE  1
```

The generic UART creator sets this at:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/wireless/bluetooth/bt_uart_generic.c:81-88`

```c
upper->dev.head_reserve = H4_HEADER_SIZE;
upper->dev.open         = btuart_open;
upper->dev.send         = btuart_send;
upper->dev.close        = btuart_close;
upper->dev.ioctl        = btuart_ioctl;
```

For controllers whose API accepts HCI packets without an H:4 byte, use:

```c
.head_reserve = 0
```

The STM32WB controller is an example:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/stm32wb/stm32wb_blehci.c:120-125`

```c

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c:1635-1641`

            FAR struct bt_buf_s *buf)
{

`data` points to the HCI packet itself. `len` excludes any transport byte represented by `head_reserve`.

The `type` values are defined at:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_buf.h:54-63`

```c

BT_ACL_OUT,   /* Outgoing ACL data */
BT_ACL_IN,    /* Incoming ACL data */
BT_ISO_OUT,   /* Outgoing ISO data */
BT_ISO_IN,    /* Incoming ISO data */
BT_DUMMY
```

For outgoing HCI transport, a lower-half driver normally accepts only:

- `BT_CMD`
- `BT_ACL_OUT`
- optionally `BT_ISO_OUT`

Generic H:4 send behavior:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/drivers/wireless/bluetooth/bt_uart.c:210-259`

```c
FAR uint8_t *hdr = (FAR uint8_t *)data - dev->head_reserve;

if (type == BT_CMD)
  {
    *hdr = H4_CMD;
  }
else if (type == BT_ACL_OUT)
  {
    *hdr = H4_ACL;
  }
else if (type == BT_ISO_OUT)
  {
    *hdr = H4_ISO;
  }
else
  {
    return -EINVAL;
  }

len += H4_HEADER_SIZE;
lower->write(lower, hdr + ntotal, len - ntotal);
```

Thus, for an H:4 driver:

```c
uint8_t *h4 = (uint8_t *)data - btdev->head_reserve;
*h4 = H4_CMD;       /* or H4_ACL/H4_ISO */
send_hardware(h4, len + btdev->head_reserve);
```

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/stm32wb/stm32wb_blehci.c:147-188`

It sends only command and ACL packets to the mailbox controller and returns `len` on success.

The return value should be:

- negative errno on failure;
- normally the number of HCI payload bytes accepted, or any nonnegative success value if the caller only checks for failure.

The current tree is inconsistent here:

- generic UART returns `OK` at line 259;
- simulator HCI socket returns `len` at lines 119-121;
- ESP32 returns `len` even when `esp32_vhci_host_check_send_available()` is false at lines 233-238.

Prototype:

```c

```

The lower-half driver generally does not initialize this field itself. The network registration layer fills it:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_netdev.c:1235`

```c

The convenience macro is:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_driver.h:49-50`

```c

A hardware RX path should call:

```c

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/xtensa/src/esp32/esp32_ble.c:147-177`

      break;

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c:1811-1830` and `1841-1890`.

## `struct bt_buf_s`

File:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_buf.h:92-111`

```c
struct bt_buf_s
{
  FAR struct bt_buf_s *flink;

  union
  {
    struct bt_buf_hci_data_s hci;
    struct bt_buf_acl_data_s acl;
  } u;

  FAR uint8_t *data;
  uint8_t len;
  uint8_t pool;

```

Important details:

- `data` points to the first byte of the HCI packet.
- `len` is the HCI packet length beginning at `data`.
- `frame` owns the backing `iob_s`.
- `ref` is a reference count; use `bt_buf_addref()` and `bt_buf_release()`.
- `len` is only `uint8_t` in this tree.
- `frame->io_len` includes the IOB offset, while `bt_buf_s::len` excludes the reserved headroom.

Prototype:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_buf.h:156-158`

# 5. Smallest board-side custom GATT read/write/CCC/notify fixture

## Important registration limitation

`bt_gatt_register()` merely replaces a single global database pointer:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:98-109`

```c
static FAR const struct bt_gatt_attr_s *g_db = NULL;
static size_t g_attr_count = 0;

void bt_gatt_register(FAR const struct bt_gatt_attr_s *attrs, size_t count)
{
  g_db         = attrs;
  g_attr_count = count;
}
```

There is no append API and no registration list.

Because `bt_netdev_register()` calls `bt_add_services()` before returning, the board-side custom database must be registered **after** `bt_driver_register()` returns if the board uses the network/host path.

However, replacing the database this way also replaces the built-in GAP service. If the built-in GAP service must be retained, define one combined static array containing both the GAP attributes and the custom attributes. The private `g_attrs` in `bt_services.c` cannot be reused directly because it is `static`.

## Attribute structure and callbacks

`struct bt_gatt_attr_s` is defined at:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h:462-497`

```c
struct bt_gatt_attr_s
{
  FAR const struct bt_uuid_s *uuid;

  CODE int (*read)(FAR struct bt_conn_s *conn,
                   FAR const struct bt_gatt_attr_s *attr,
                   FAR void *buf, uint8_t len, uint16_t offset);

  CODE int (*write)(FAR struct bt_conn_s *conn,
                    FAR const struct bt_gatt_attr_s *attr,
                    FAR const void *buf, uint8_t len, uint16_t offset);

  CODE int (*flush)(FAR struct bt_conn_s *conn,
                    FAR const struct bt_gatt_attr_s *attr,
                    uint8_t flags);

  FAR void *user_data;
  uint16_t handle;
  uint8_t perm;
};
```

UUID layout:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_uuid.h:219-244`

```c
struct bt_uuid_s
{
  uint8_t type;
  union
  {
    uint16_t u16;
    uint8_t u128[16];
  } u;
};
```

The smallest practical fixture is four attributes:

1. primary service;
2. characteristic declaration;
3. characteristic value;
4. CCC descriptor.

The macros are defined at:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h:222-235`, `291-304`, and `316-336`.

## Minimal fixture

This is an illustrative board-side fixture; it is not written into the tree.

```c

#include <string.h>

#include <nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_core.h>
#include <nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h>
#include <nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.h>
#include <nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_uuid.h>

#define FIXTURE_SVC_HANDLE   0x0100
#define FIXTURE_CHRC_HANDLE  0x0101
#define FIXTURE_VALUE_HANDLE 0x0102
#define FIXTURE_CCC_HANDLE   0x0103

static uint8_t g_fixture_value[20] =
{
  0
};

static bool g_fixture_notify_enabled;

static struct bt_uuid_s g_fixture_service_uuid =
{
  .type = BT_UUID_16,
  .u.u16 = 0xfff0
};

static struct bt_uuid_s g_fixture_value_uuid =
{
  .type = BT_UUID_16,
  .u.u16 = 0xfff1
};

static struct bt_gatt_chrc_s g_fixture_chrc =
{
  .uuid         = &g_fixture_value_uuid,
  .value_handle = FIXTURE_VALUE_HANDLE,
  .properties   = BT_GATT_CHRC_READ |
                  BT_GATT_CHRC_WRITE |
                  BT_GATT_CHRC_WRITE_WITHOUT_RESP |
                  BT_GATT_CHRC_NOTIFY
};

static struct bt_gatt_ccc_cfg_s
  g_fixture_ccc_cfg[CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAX_CONN];

static int fixture_read(FAR struct bt_conn_s *conn,
                        FAR const struct bt_gatt_attr_s *attr,
                        FAR void *buf, uint8_t len, uint16_t offset)
{
  return bt_gatt_attr_read(conn, attr, buf, len, offset,
                           g_fixture_value, sizeof(g_fixture_value));
}

static int fixture_write(FAR struct bt_conn_s *conn,
                         FAR const struct bt_gatt_attr_s *attr,
                         FAR const void *buf, uint8_t len,
                         uint16_t offset)
{
  if (offset > sizeof(g_fixture_value) ||
      len > sizeof(g_fixture_value) - offset)
    {
      return -EINVAL;
    }

  memcpy(&g_fixture_value[offset], buf, len);

  /*
   * Optional: notify the new value immediately after a client write.
   * Calling bt_gatt_notify() is also valid from board/application logic.
   */
  bt_gatt_notify(FIXTURE_VALUE_HANDLE,
                 g_fixture_value, sizeof(g_fixture_value));

  return len;
}

static void fixture_ccc_changed(uint16_t value)
{
  g_fixture_notify_enabled = (value == BT_GATT_CCC_NOTIFY);
}

static const struct bt_gatt_attr_s g_fixture_attrs[] =
{
  BT_GATT_PRIMARY_SERVICE(FIXTURE_SVC_HANDLE,
                          &g_fixture_service_uuid),

  BT_GATT_CHARACTERISTIC(FIXTURE_CHRC_HANDLE,
                         &g_fixture_chrc),

  BT_GATT_DESCRIPTOR(FIXTURE_VALUE_HANDLE,
                     &g_fixture_value_uuid,
                     BT_GATT_PERM_READ | BT_GATT_PERM_WRITE,
                     fixture_read,
                     fixture_write,
                     g_fixture_value),

  BT_GATT_CCC(FIXTURE_CCC_HANDLE,
              FIXTURE_VALUE_HANDLE,
              g_fixture_ccc_cfg,
              fixture_ccc_changed),
};
```

Register it only after the Bluetooth network/host registration has completed:

```c

{
  /*
   * bt_driver_register() must already have completed in the host/netdev path.
   * bt_netdev_register() has already installed the built-in GAP DB by this
   * point, so this call replaces that database with g_fixture_attrs.

  bt_gatt_register(g_fixture_attrs, nitems(g_fixture_attrs));

The registration API is:

## Notification call

Use the **value attribute handle**, not the characteristic declaration handle and not the CCC handle:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h:842-857`

```c
void bt_gatt_notify(uint16_t handle,
                    FAR const void *data,
                    size_t len);
```

For the fixture:

```c
bt_gatt_notify(FIXTURE_VALUE_HANDLE,
               g_fixture_value,
               sizeof(g_fixture_value));
```

The notification implementation searches forward from that handle until it finds the CCC:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:454-463`.

It requires the CCC to be declared with `BT_GATT_CCC`; the API documentation explicitly warns about this at:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h:843-849`.

The actual notification construction is at:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:365-451`.

Important current-tree behavior:

```c

  {
    continue;
  }
```

at lines 417-420. It supports notifications only when the aggregate CCC value is exactly `BT_GATT_CCC_NOTIFY`. Indications are not implemented in this path; line 417 contains:

```c

```

## CCC requirements and traps

The CCC macro creates an internal `_bt_gatt_ccc_s` object containing:

- the configuration array;
- its length;
- the value handle;
- the callback.

`BT_GATT_CCC` is at:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h:306-336`.

The configuration callback is called without a NULL check:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:260-280`

```c
ccc->cfg_changed(value);
```

Therefore, always supply a valid `cfg_changed` callback.

CCC writes must be exactly two bytes and have zero offset:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:282-295`

```c
if (len != sizeof(*data) || offset)
  {
    return -EINVAL;
  }
```

The client writes the value in little-endian form. The supported values are:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h:180-194`

```c

BT_GATT_CCC_INDICATE 0x0002
```

CCC configurations are peer-specific and use `bt_addr_le_t`:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.h:569-584`.

The configuration array should therefore have at least one entry for a one-connection board, or `CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAX_CONN` entries for a general fixture.

The implementation’s handling of unbonded peers is unusual:

`/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:297-329`

- it stores the peer address;
- it sets `.valid` only if the peer is bonded;
- it nevertheless stores the CCC value.

This is a current-tree behavior to account for when persisting CCC state.

# 6. Custom advertising data for the fixture

If the service UUID should appear in advertising, use an additional advertising array such as:

```c
static const struct bt_eir_s g_fixture_ad[] =
{
  {
    .len  = 2,
    .type = BT_EIR_FLAGS,
    .data = { BT_LE_AD_GENERAL | BT_LE_AD_NO_BREDR }
  },
  {
    .len  = 3,
    .type = BT_EIR_UUID16_ALL,
    .data = { 0xf0, 0xff }       /* UUID 0xfff0, little endian */
  },
  {
    .len  = 0
  }
};

static const struct bt_eir_s g_fixture_sd[] =
{
  {
    .len  = 8,                   /* type + seven name bytes */
    .type = BT_EIR_NAME_COMPLETE,
    .data = "Fixture"
  },
  {
    .len  = 0
  }
};
```

After the host registration has completed:

```c
int board_fixture_advertise(void)
{
  int ret;

  ret = bt_stop_advertising();
  if (ret < 0 && ret != -EALREADY)
    {
      return ret;
    }

  return bt_start_advertising(BT_LE_ADV_IND,
                              g_fixture_ad,
                              g_fixture_sd);
}
```

If the existing default advertisement is sufficient, do not restart advertising merely to install the GATT database. `bt_gatt_register()` changes the server database; it does not itself change advertising data.

# 7. Recommended board initialization order

For a controller-specific board driver using the host/network path:

```text
1. Initialize controller hardware, clocks, transport, and interrupts.
2. Construct a persistent struct bt_driver_s.
3. Set:
     head_reserve
     open
     send
     close, if needed
     ioctl, if needed
4. Call bt_driver_register(&driver).
5. Confirm the registration path is bt_netdev_register(), not UART_BTH4.
6. bt_netdev_register() internally:
     - installs receive = bt_receive
     - bt_driver_set()
     - bt_initialize()
     - driver->open()
     - HCI initialization
     - L2CAP initialization
     - built-in GAP registration
     - default advertising
7. After bt_driver_register() returns:
     - call bt_gatt_register() with the persistent custom database
     - optionally restart advertising with custom AD/scan-response data
8. Later, call bt_gatt_notify(value_handle, data, len) from board/application logic.
```

# 8. Version-specific and tree-specific traps

1. **`CONFIG_UART_BTH4` takes precedence over `CONFIG_NET_BLUETOOTH`.**  
   `bt_driver_register()` may create `/dev/ttyHCI<N>` instead of initializing the host stack. See:

2. **`receive` is registration-filled in the network path.**  
   Do not overwrite `bt_net` and do not assume the driver should install its own `receive` callback. `bt_net` is reserved for the stack; `priv` is for the lower half:

   `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_driver.h:99-110`

3. **Only one low-level driver is supported by `bt_driver_set()`.**

   `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_hcicore.c:1757-1761`

4. **The GATT database is a single global pointer.**  
   `bt_gatt_register()` replaces, rather than extends, the previous database:

   `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:98-109`

5. **The default GAP database is private.**  
   The board cannot reuse `bt_services.c:g_attrs` directly. A custom combined database must duplicate the needed GAP attribute definitions.

6. **Registering custom GATT data before `bt_driver_register()` does not work in the host/netdev path.**  
   `bt_netdev_register()` later calls `bt_add_services()`, which overwrites the database with the built-in one:

   `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_netdev.c:1279-1281`

7. **The custom attribute array must remain alive.**  
   The stack keeps the pointer; it does not copy attributes or UUIDs.

   `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:275-279`

   Passing the characteristic declaration or CCC handle causes lookup behavior different from the intended notification path:

   `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth/bt_gatt.c:454-463`

10. **Indications are not implemented by the current notification path.**

Use this exact handle allocation, above the built-in GAP service:

- Make handle `0x0008` bounded read/write storage.
- Use `BT_GATT_CCC()` for handle `0x000b`.

- Use a bounded, low-frequency worker, for example one byte per 1000 ms.

55: ## 3. 架构和资源所有权
56: 
57: ### 3.1 固定架构结论
58: 
59: - BK7258 AP 是 Cortex-M33 / ARMv8-M Mainline / Thumb / hard-float，不是 Cortex-A / ARMv8-A。
60: - 不得引入 `arch/arm64`、GIC、AArch64、generic timer、MMU/页表、TF-A/BL31 或 `OUTPUT_ARCH(aarch64)`。
61: - BK7258 是三核 AMP：物理 CPU0 运行 Armino CP，CPU1 是 OpenVela AP primary，CPU2 是 AP secondary。
62: - AP 内部 SMP 时 CPU1/CPU2 运行同一个 `nuttx.bin`，映射为 NuttX 逻辑 CPU0/CPU1。
63: - 当前运行基线是 CPU1 单核，CPU2 SMP 尚未实现。
64: 
65: ### 3.2 CPU0/CP 保留职责
66: 
67: CP 继续拥有并负责：
68: 
69: - bootloader、CP 固件和 FreeRTOS 运行环境
70: - 中央电源/时钟管理、硬件 WDT
71: - PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟、控制器和器件 ID 检测
72: - Flash 擦写编程
73: - Wi-Fi controller、RWNX/UMAC/LMAC/MAC/PHY/RF
74: - Bluetooth BTDM controller-only
75: - CP UART0 物理日志口
76: 
77: AP 不得重复执行与 CP 冲突的 PHY、时钟、电源或控制器初始化。
78: 
79: ### 3.3 内存地址来源
80: 
81: Flash、SRAM、PSRAM 和保留区地址来自目标 `app_ab` 分区生成结果，不是 BK7258 芯片常量：
82: 
83: ```text
84: AP Flash XIP:    0x02150000 (当前 app_ab 布局)
85: AP 私有 SRAM:    0x28010000..0x28064000 (336 KiB)
86: AP_SPINLOCK:     0x28000000..0x2800ffff
87: CP_RAM:          0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
88: PWR_MNG:         0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
89: PSRAM 窗口:      0x60000000..0x60ffffff (当前 16 MiB 布局)
90: ```
91: 
92: AP 不得清零 CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP，不得把 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放入 heap，不得覆盖 CP 的 128 KiB PSRAM heap。

95: 
96: AP 镜像只能通过 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN` 接口注入打包流程，不得手工覆盖 `package/tmp/app1.bin`。

98: ### 3.5 AP 控制台
99: 
100: 正式 AP 日志路径是 Mailbox UART -> CP UART0。物理 UART1 不是交付控制台，不接管 GPIO0/1。
101:

91: 复位后自动恢复，必须进入第 11.2 节的 CP 协议演进，不能靠 AP 本地 generation

94: ## 2. 已核验的原厂协议
95: 
96: ### 2.1 最终配置和初始化链
97: 
98: 当前生成配置：
99: 
100: ```text
101: AP reference:
102:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_AP=y
103:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_HOST_ONLY=y
104:   CONFIG_BLE=y
105:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_SUPPORT_IPC=y
106: 
107: CP final:
108:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH=y
109:   CONFIG_BLE=y
110:   CONFIG_BTDM_5_2=y
111:   CONFIG_BTDM_CONTROLLER_ONLY=y
112:   CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_SUPPORT_IPC=y
113: ```
114: 
115: 证据：
116: 
117: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h`
118: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.h`
119: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/app.map`
120: 
121: 原 AP 顺序是 `bt_ipc_init()`、vendor INIT、AP OS/feature adapter、HCI driver、
122: Armino Host。OpenVela 替换 AP Host 和 AP OS adapter，不改变 CP controller 所有权。
123: 当前 CP 在系统 `bk_init()` 阶段已经调用 `bk_bluetooth_init()`；因此 AP vendor INIT
124: 在当前固件上通常是幂等同步握手，不应描述成必然首次启动 controller。
125: 
126: ### 2.2 logical channel
127: 
128: ```text
129: AP -> CP: MB_CHNL_BT_CMD = 0x13
130: CP -> AP: MB_CHNL_BT_CMD = 0x43
131: ```
132: 
133: 编码为 `destination[7:6] | source[5:4] | logical-id[3:0]`。依据：
134: 
135: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h`
136: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h`
137: - AP/CP `components/bk_bluetooth/ipc/src/bt_ipc_core.c`
138: 
139: ### 2.3 16-byte HCI descriptor ABI
140: 
141: 原厂定义：
142: 
143: ```c
144: struct bk7258_bt_descriptor
145: {
146:   uint32_t header;       /* offset 0, cmd/state/ctrl/seq/channel */
147:   uint8_t  packet_type;  /* offset 4 */
148:   uint8_t  pointer[4];   /* offset 5, little-endian, unaligned */
149:   uint8_t  reserved[7];  /* offset 9, must be zero in OpenVela */
150: } __attribute__((packed));
151: ```
152: 
153: packet type：
154: 
155: ```text
156: HCI_COMMAND_PKT  = 0x01
157: HCI_ACL_DATA_PKT = 0x02
158: HCI_SCO_DATA_PKT = 0x03
159: HCI_EVENT_PKT    = 0x04
160: HCI_FREE_PKT     = 0x0a
161: ```
162: 
163: 原 `hci_hdr_t` 是 9 字节，`hdr_ptr` offset 为 5；它与 16 字节
164: `bt_ipc_cmd_t/mb_chnl_cmd_t` union 共用存储。所有 OpenVela TX descriptor 必须先
165: 清零完整 16 字节，`header.cmd` 固定为 0，再由 Mailbox 层填 state、ctrl、seq 和
166: channel。pointer 必须用 `memcpy` 或逐字节 helper 访问，不能对 packed offset 5
167: 执行未对齐 `uint32_t` 解引用。
168: 
169: 当前 `struct bk7258_mb_wire_message` 的 offset 4 是 `payload_address`，offset 8
170: 是 `payload_length`，与上述 BT descriptor 不兼容。BT 代码不得把 pointer 写入
171: `message.payload_address`。必须增加 raw 16-byte overlay/accessor；通用 message
172: 和 BT descriptor 只能共享 header 以及“总长 16 字节”这一事实。
173: 
174: 建议在 `hardware/bk7258_bt_ipc.h` 固定：
175: 
176: ```c
177: union bk7258_mb_frame
178: {
179:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message generic;
180:   struct bk7258_bt_descriptor bt;
181:   uint8_t raw[BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE];
182: };
183: 
184: _Static_assert(sizeof(union bk7258_mb_frame) == 16, "mailbox frame size");
185: _Static_assert(offsetof(struct bk7258_bt_descriptor, packet_type) == 4,
186:                "BT packet type offset");
187: _Static_assert(offsetof(struct bk7258_bt_descriptor, pointer) == 5,
188:                "BT pointer offset");
189: ```
190: 
191: Mailbox transport内部存储、send 和 RX callback改用 `union bk7258_mb_frame`，或提供
192: 等价的 raw 16-byte API。对非 BT channel 继续使用 `.generic`；对 `0x13/0x43`
193: 只使用 `.bt/.raw`，不得读取 `payload_length/flags/crc8`。
194: 
195: ### 2.4 payload 和三类完成语义
196: 
197: descriptor 只携带 pointer，实际 HCI payload 位于发送方可被另一核访问的内存：
198: 
199: ```c
200: struct hci_cmd  { le16 opcode; u8 len; u8 params[]; } packed;
201: struct hci_evt  { u8 event; u8 len; u8 params[]; } packed;
202: struct hci_acl  { le16 handle_flags; le16 len; u8 data[]; } packed;
203: ```
204: 
205: 三类完成语义不能混用：
206: 
207: 1. Mailbox ACK：对端 logical layer 已复制 16-byte descriptor。
208: 2. Beken `HCI_FREE_PKT`：对端已处理 wrapper，原分配方可以回收 pointer。
209: 3. HCI Complete/Status 或 Number Of Completed Packets：controller 协议结果/credit。
210: 
211: AP/CP 收到 Event、Command 或 ACL wrapper后会向原分配方回发
212: `HCI_FREE_PKT(pointer)`。收到 FREE 的原厂 CP 会直接 `os_free(pointer)`，所以 AP
213: 不能把一个未经白名单验证的 CP pointer原样回发给 CP。
214: 
215: ### 2.5 vendor INIT ABI
216: 
217: ```text
218: HCI vendor opcode: 0xfefe
219: INIT sub-opcode:    0x0001
220: DEINIT sub-opcode:  0x0002
221: 
222: AP -> CP INIT params:       00 01
223: CP -> AP vendor event data: 01 00 status
224: ```
225: 
226: 两条路径的 sub-opcode 字节序不同，必须逐字节编码：
227: 
228: - AP 发送 `[subop >> 8, subop & 0xff]`。
229: - CP 回复 `[subop & 0xff, subop >> 8, status]`。
230: 
231: CP 回复是 event code `0xfe`，不是普通 HCI Command Complete。transport在 Host
232: 初始化前拦截该 event、验证长度和 sub-opcode、更新 ready状态并 FREE CP wrapper；
233: 不能把它直接提交给尚未 ready 的 NuttX Host。
234: 
235: ## 3. 当前实现状态和真正缺口
236: 
237: 当前 OpenVela 已具备：
238: 
239: - CPU1 MBOX0 channel 1 FIFO、IRQ79 和 16-byte descriptor deferral。
240: - `bk7258_mailbox_send_wire()` 通用异步发送和 TX complete callback。
241: - `bk7258_mailbox_register_rx()` per-channel RX callback。
242: - 8 个稳定 ACK slots，ACK 优先于 reset 和普通 command。
243: - 单 active transaction、每 logical channel 一个 pending slot。
244: - 200 ms timeout、link reset/probe、`peer_reset_generation`。
245: - CP SRAM `0x28064000..0x2809f6ff` non-cacheable/shareable MPU 映射。
246: 
247: 证据位于：
248: 
249: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_mbox.h`
250: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`
251: - `board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c`
252: 
253: 不要重复实现上述能力。真正缺口是：
254: 
255: | 缺口 | 必须实现的结果 |
256: | --- | --- |
257: | BT channel ID | TX `0x13`、RX `0x43` 加入白名单和 callback table |
258: | raw frame | BT offset 4/5 ABI，不复用 generic payload字段 |
259: | 硬编码索引 | 删除 `g_channels[4]`，按 UART channel ID 查询索引 |
260: | BT TX queue | 在 generic transport之上增加有界优先级队列 |
261: | AP TX pool | 固定 AP SRAM wrapper，直到匹配 FREE 才复用 |
262: | CP pointer校验 | SRAM窗口、总长、overflow、type、重复 descriptor |
263: | RX worker | ISR只复制 descriptor，worker校验、copy、deliver、FREE |
264: | NuttX lower-half | `bt_driver_s`、Kconfig、Make/CMake、board bring-up |
265: | HCI恢复 | quarantine、DEINIT/INIT和明确的不可恢复边界 |
266: | 测试工具 | `btsak` 和可写/可通知的最小 GATT fixture |
267: 
268: 当前每个 logical channel 只有一个 pending slot，第二个请求返回 `-EBUSY`。BT 同一
269: channel需要发送 FREE、vendor command、HCI command和ACL，因此不能让 Host直接调用
270: `bk7258_mailbox_send_wire()`。否则 FREE 会被普通 command/ACL 阻塞，且 NuttX TX
271: 线程未必重试 lower-half 的 `-EBUSY`。
272: 
273: ## 4. 正式代码结构
274: 
275: 新增和修改：
276: 
277: ```text
278: board/beken/chips/bk7258/
279: ├── hardware/bk7258_mbox.h         # raw frame API和0x13/0x43
280: ├── hardware/bk7258_bt_ipc.h       # Beken BT wire ABI、assert和accessor
281: ├── bk7258_mailbox_channel.c       # BT channel、raw dispatch、索引修复
282: ├── bk7258_bt_transport.c          # queue/pool/ownership/RX worker/recovery
283: ├── bk7258_bt_driver.c             # struct bt_driver_s
284: ├── bk7258_bt_selftest.c           # 可选开机raw HCI自检，不注册Host
285: ├── bk7258_bt.h                    # board可调用的初始化/诊断API
286: ├── Kconfig
287: ├── CMakeLists.txt
288: └── Make.defs
289: 
290: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/
291: ├── bk7258_bringup.c               # link/PWC ready后注册BT
292: ├── bk7258_bt_gatt_test.c          # 可选最小GATT验收服务
293: ├── CMakeLists.txt
294: └── Makefile
295: ```
296: 
297: 所有 BT 源码在 Make/CMake 两侧都受 `CONFIG_BK7258_BLUETOOTH` 条件控制。不要
298: 修改 `openvela/nuttx/wireless/bluetooth` 公共代码来掩盖 controller 错误。
299: 
300: ## 5. Transport 设计
301: 
302: ### 5.1 Mailbox channel接入
303: 
304: 在原厂优先级顺序中，BT 位于 PWC 后、Wi-Fi 前：
305: 
306: ```text
307: HW_CTRL, PWC, BT, WIFI_CMD, WIFI_DATA, UART0
308: ```
309: 
310: 修改时同时更新 TX/RX count、ID数组、callback数组、统计和 dump。先把：
311: 
312: ```c
313: g_channels[4].queued
314: ```
315: 
316: 改为通过 `channel_index(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX)` 获取，避免插入 BT 后 probe
317: 检查错误 channel。
318: 
319: generic Mailbox层仍只负责：
320: 
321: - 赋 logical channel和sequence。
322: - 一次发送一个 descriptor。
323: - 匹配 transport ACK。
324: - timeout和link状态。
325: 
326: 它不理解 HCI payload，也不根据 `HCI_FREE_PKT` 回收内存。
327: 
328: ### 5.2 BT出站队列
329: 
330: `bk7258_bt_transport.c` 在 generic transport之上维护一个有界队列。建议初值：
331: 
332: ```text
333: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_TX_BUFFERS=8
334: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_TX_QUEUE=16
335: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RX_QUEUE=16
336: ```
337: 
338: 调度规则：
339: 
340: 1. 已验证 CP pointer 的 `HCI_FREE_PKT`。
341: 2. vendor INIT/DEINIT 和恢复控制。
342: 3. 普通 HCI Command和ACL按全局入队顺序发送，不跨类型重排。
343: 
344: 恢复控制只在Host已quiesce后进入队列，不能越过仍有效的普通HCI业务。必须为FREE和
345: Command保留容量，ACL不能占满所有项。
346: `bt_driver_s.send()` 在复制 payload并成功入队后返回 `len`；失败返回负 errno。
347: Command使用保留 slot或有界等待，ACL queue满返回 `-ENOBUFS`。任何路径都不能在
348: Mailbox ISR中等待 semaphore。
349: 
350: generic TX complete只表示 descriptor ACK：
351: 
352: - ACK成功：payload保持 `IN_FLIGHT`，等待 FREE。
353: - ACK失败且 descriptor确认未交给 CP：可回收 payload。
354: - timeout/结果不确定：payload进入 quarantine，不能立即复用。
355: 
356: ### 5.3 AP HCI TX pool
357: 
358: 第一版固定使用 AP SRAM中的静态小对象池，不使用任意 NuttX heap pointer，也不把
359: HCI pool放入 PSRAM。当前 AP SRAM和CP SRAM映射均为 non-cacheable，仍需在 B0
360: 设计时核对地址，在 B1通过真实无副作用HCI command证明 CPU0能读取 AP pool内容。
361: 
362: 每个对象记录：
363: 
364: ```text
365: state, generation, wire_address, packet_type, length, enqueue_time
366: ```
367: 
368: 状态：
369: 
370: ```text
371: FREE -> BUILDING -> QUEUED -> IN_FLIGHT -> FREE_RECEIVED -> FREE
372:                                   |
373:                                   +-> QUARANTINED
374: ```
375: 
376: 收到 `HCI_FREE_PKT` 时只能按 wire address查 ownership table。仅完全匹配当前
377: `IN_FLIGHT` 对象才回收；unknown、duplicate、旧 generation和非对象起始地址均记录
378: 错误并触发受控恢复，绝不调用 `kmm_free(remote_pointer)`。
379: 
380: ### 5.4 AP发送 Command/ACL
381: 
382: NuttX lower-half只接受 `BT_CMD` 和 `BT_ACL_OUT`：
383: 
384: ```text
385: send(type, data, len)
386:   -> 验证type、HCI header和len
387:   -> 从AP pool分配完整wrapper
388:   -> memcpy NuttX HCI header+payload，不添加H4 byte
389:   -> 构造清零的16-byte BT descriptor
390:   -> 入BT优先级队列
391:   -> 返回len
392:   -> generic mailbox发送并收到ACK
393:   -> 等CP发HCI_FREE_PKT
394:   -> ownership匹配后回收wrapper
395: ```
396: 
397: Host在 `send()` 返回后可以复用原 buffer，所以必须复制。HCI multi-byte字段使用
398: little-endian helper或 `memcpy`，不能直接访问 packed halfword。
399: 
400: ### 5.5 CP接收 Event/ACL
401: 
402: ```text
403: Mailbox IRQ / logical RX callback
404:   -> 只验证channel、descriptor type
405:   -> 复制完整16字节到BT RX queue
406:   -> 不解引用CP pointer
407: 
408: BT RX worker
409:   -> 解析unaligned pointer
410:   -> 验证pointer窗口和最小header
411:   -> 用memcpy读取Event/ACL length
412:   -> 验证pointer + total不overflow、不越窗口、不超Host上限
413:   -> 复制到本地临时buffer
414:   -> Event: bt_netdev_receive(driver, BT_EVT, data, total)
415:   -> ACL:   bt_netdev_receive(driver, BT_ACL_IN, data, total)
416:   -> 成功或Host明确拒绝后，为可信wrapper排队HCI_FREE_PKT
417: ```
418: 
419: 传给 NuttX 的 data从 Event/ACL header开始，不包含 H4 type。`bt_receive()` 自己会
420: 再次复制并投递 HPWORK/LPWORK，所以本地临时buffer在其返回后可释放。
421: 
422: RX queue必须保持原 descriptor顺序。不能为了“Event优先”越过先到的 ACL；NuttX
423: 在 `bt_receive()` 后已经会把 Command Complete/Status和 Number Of Completed
424: Packets投递 HPWORK。queue满时不能静默丢包：停止接收新业务、记录未释放可信
425: pointer并进入恢复；完全非法 pointer不回发 FREE，因为 CP会直接对收到的地址
426: 执行 `os_free()`。
427: 
428: 具体 backpressure 使用现有 descriptor deferral：RX callback在本地queue满时返回
429: `-EAGAIN`，不发送该 descriptor 的 transport ACK；worker释放queue空间后调用
430: `bk7258_mbox_kick_rx()`，使同一 descriptor按原FIFO顺序重试。若持续超过有界超时，
431: 才进入恢复。不能在queue满后返回成功并丢弃pointer。
432: 
433: ### 5.6 pointer、长度和Host上限
434: 
435: 第一阶段 CP outbound wrapper白名单先限定当前 CP SRAM：
436: 
437: ```text
438: 0x28064000 <= pointer < 0x2809f700
439: ```
440: 
441: 原因是当前 `bt_ipc_core` 使用 `os_malloc`，最终 CP开启 `CONFIG_MEM_DEBUG`，现有
442: 源码路径指向 CP SRAM allocator。只有 golden trace实际出现 PSRAM pointer且确认
443: allocator边界后，才能增加 PSRAM白名单。不能把整个 `0x60000000..0x60ffffff`
444: 直接设为可接受窗口。
445: 
446: 长度规则：
447: 
448: - Event total = `2 + param_len`。
449: - ACL total = `4 + little_endian(datalen)`。
450: - AP -> CP ACL上限来自 controller `LE Read Buffer Size`。
451: - CP -> AP ACL上限来自 AP发送的 `Host Buffer Size`。
452: - 两个方向还必须满足当前 NuttX `BLUETOOTH_MAX_FRAMELEN`。当前源码值为 79字节；
453:   driver在调用 `bt_netdev_receive()` 前必须显式检查，因为 `bt_receive()` copy前没有
454:   独立的传入长度上限保护。
455: - `param_len <= 255` 不是有效门禁，因为字段本身就是 `uint8_t`；真正门禁是总长、
456:   pointer窗口和Host buffer容量。
457: 
458: ### 5.7 四种流控统计
459: 
460: 分别统计，禁止合并：
461: 
462: - Mailbox descriptor ACK。
463: - Beken `HCI_FREE_PKT` wrapper回收。
464: - Controller `Number Of Completed Packets`，归还 AP -> CP ACL credit。
465: - Host `Host Number Of Completed Packets`，归还 CP -> AP ACL credit。
466: 
467: NuttX Host初始化还会发送 `Host Buffer Size` 和 `Set Controller To Host Flow Control`。
468: B2必须验证这些命令，不得只验证 `LE Read Buffer Size`。
469: 
470: ## 6. NuttX lower-half和生命周期
471: 
472: ### 6.1 Driver对象
473: 
474: ```c
475: static struct bt_driver_s g_bk7258_bt_driver =
476: {
477:   .head_reserve = 0,
478:   .open         = bk7258_bt_open,
479:   .send         = bk7258_bt_send,
480:   .close        = bk7258_bt_close,
481:   .ioctl        = NULL,
482:   .priv         = &g_bk7258_bt_priv,
483:   /* receive和bt_net由bt_netdev_register()填写。 */
484: };
485: ```
486: 
487: `head_reserve=0`，因为 Beken wrapper不使用H4 byte。第一版不启用
488: `CONFIG_DRIVERS_BLUETOOTH`，使 `bt_driver_register()` 直接映射到
489: `bt_netdev_register()`；当前 `CONFIG_DRIVERS_BLUETOOTH` wrapper的 unregister路径
490: 不适合作为恢复基础。
491: 
492: ### 6.2 唯一初始化顺序
493: 
494: 采用一个明确模型，不在 register前和 `open()` 中重复 INIT：
495: 
496: ```text
497: board late bring-up
498:   -> mailbox link READY
499:   -> PWC/heartbeat已启动
500:   -> bk7258_bt_transport_initialize()
501:        注册0x43 RX callback并启动TX/RX worker
502:   -> bt_driver_register(&g_bk7258_bt_driver)
503:        -> 注册层先填写driver.receive
504:        -> bt_initialize()
505:           -> driver.open()
506:              -> 发送vendor INIT
507:              -> transport拦截0xfe ready event
508:              -> 等待status==0
509:              -> 为CP vendor-event wrapper排队FREE
510:              -> 等待CP对AP vendor-command wrapper返回匹配FREE
511:              -> 返回OK
512:           -> NuttX立即执行标准HCI初始化
513:        -> bt_add_services()
514:           -> 注册GAP服务并自动开始advertising
515:        -> 注册bnep0
516: ```
517: 
518: `open()` 使用有界 5秒等待。timeout返回 `-ETIMEDOUT`，不能假装成功。vendor event
519: 只在 `open()` 的预Host状态拦截；ready后其他标准Event交给 NuttX。
520: 
521: `bt_netdev_register()` 当前会调用 `bt_add_services()` 并自动 advertising。因此阶段
522: B3的成功条件必须包括默认 advertising；不能写成“B3只初始化、B4才首次启动”。
523: 
524: ### 6.3 close和恢复
525: 
526: `close()`：
527: 
528: 1. 禁止新 Host send。
529: 2. 等待已知 in-flight payload有界清空。
530: 3. 发送 vendor DEINIT并等待匹配 event。
531: 4. 停止 BT worker或置为 quiesced。
532: 5. 有不确定 ownership 时保留 quarantine，不复用地址。
533: 
534: 当前 `bt_netdev_unregister()` 可以执行 Host deinitialize、driver close和netdev注销，
535: 但重注册仍需验证所有 NuttX全局状态可重复初始化。第一版恢复门禁是：
536: 
537: - 无连接、无in-flight payload时 DEINIT -> INIT 100次。
538: - 整机复位后重新初始化。
539: - CP明确整核复位后再回收旧 AP payload。
540: 
541: 仅收到 Mailbox RESET/control generation不等于 CP controller已停止访问旧 pointer，
542: 不得据此清空 quarantine。
543: 
544: ## 7. Kconfig和构建接入
545: 
546: ### 7.1 配置闭包
547: 
548: `WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH` 位于 `if WIRELESS` 内并依赖 BSD许可；Bluetooth netdev还需要
549: `NET_BLUETOOTH`。最终 defconfig至少加入：
550: 
551: ```text
552: CONFIG_ALLOW_BSD_COMPONENTS=y
553: CONFIG_NET=y
554: CONFIG_NET_BLUETOOTH=y
555: CONFIG_WIRELESS=y
556: CONFIG_WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH=y
557: CONFIG_WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH_HOST=y
558: CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAX_CONN=1
559: CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAX_PAIRED=1
560: CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAXSCANRESULT=4
561: CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAXSCANDATA=64
562: CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_MAXDISCOVER=8
563: CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_BUFFER_PREALLOC=12
564: CONFIG_DEVICE_NAME="VelaSights"
565: CONFIG_DEVICE_LOCAL_NAME="VelaSights"
566: CONFIG_BTSAK=y
567: CONFIG_BK7258_BLUETOOTH=y
568: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_TX_BUFFERS=8
569: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_TX_QUEUE=16
570: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RX_QUEUE=16
571: CONFIG_BK7258_BT_GATT_TEST=y
572: # CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RAW_SELFTEST is not set
573: ```
574: 
575: 上述 pool/queue值是首轮内存预算起点，必须以 `size`、`System.map`、运行时
576: `free`和压力测试调整，不能直接宣称量产值。
577: 
578: BK7258 Kconfig使用 `depends on` 保持依赖闭包，不用 `select` 绕过
579: `WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH` 的 BSD依赖：
580: 
581: ```kconfig
582: config BK7258_BLUETOOTH
583:     bool "BK7258 CP-backed Bluetooth HCI"
584:     depends on ARCH_CHIP_BK7258
585:     depends on BK7258_MBOX_V2
586:     depends on ALLOW_BSD_COMPONENTS
587:     depends on NET && NET_BLUETOOTH
588:     depends on WIRELESS && WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH
589:     depends on WIRELESS_BLUETOOTH_HOST
590: ```
591: 
592: ### 7.2 Make/CMake
593: 
594: Chip `CMakeLists.txt`：
595: 
596: ```cmake
597: if(CONFIG_BK7258_BLUETOOTH)
598:   list(APPEND SRCS bk7258_bt_transport.c bk7258_bt_driver.c)
599: endif()
600: ```
601: 
602: `Make.defs` 使用等价的 `ifeq ($(CONFIG_BK7258_BLUETOOTH),y)`。board GATT fixture
603: 同样在 `src/CMakeLists.txt` 和 `src/Makefile` 条件加入。修改 Kconfig/defconfig后先
604: 执行 CMake distclean。
605: 
606: 增加 `CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RAW_SELFTEST`，依赖 `BK7258_BLUETOOTH`，默认关闭。启用时
607: board bring-up只初始化BT transport并运行第B1/B2阶段的开机自检，打印逐opcode结果，
608: 随后保持transport在诊断态，不调用 `bt_driver_register()`。这样raw测试和正式Host
609: 不会同时消费同一Event，也不需要在apps或CP中增加临时命令。正式功能构建必须关闭
610: 该符号。
611: 
612: 增加 `CONFIG_BK7258_BT_GATT_TEST`，依赖 `BK7258_BLUETOOTH`，默认关闭；验收构建显式
613: 启用，量产构建关闭。该符号同时控制board GATT fixture源码和notification worker，
614: 避免测试service进入量产镜像。
615: 
616: ## 8. 分阶段实施和验收
617: 
618: ### B0：冻结输入和ABI
619: 
620: 输出一份同日记录，包含：
621: 
622: - CP `app.bin`、`app.map`、`sdkconfig.h` SHA256。
623: - 实际 controller archive名称。
624: - AP/CP toolchain下 descriptor `sizeof/offsetof`。
625: - AP/CP channel ID和packet type常量。
626: - vendor INIT/DEINIT逐字节 trace。
627: - 由生成RAM布局得到的CP SRAM coarse envelope和AP pool候选地址。
628: 
629: 这些未完成前不注册 NuttX Host。
630: 
631: ### B1：raw BT logical transport
632: 
633: 启用 `CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RAW_SELFTEST=y`，实现 `0x13/0x43`、raw frame、UART索引
634: 修复、BT TX/RX queue和统计。由于正式 CP
635: 没有任意 BT descriptor echo入口，不执行“无 HCI语义双向 loopback”：
636: 
637: - AP -> CP先完成一次vendor INIT，再对无副作用的 Read Local Version Information做
638:   10,000次顺序事务；每次都先回收response wrapper和command wrapper，再开始下一次。
639: - CP -> AP通过真实 vendor event和Command Complete验证。
640: - 记录CP Event wrapper实际pointer分布，并用Command Complete证明CP读取到AP SRAM
641:   pool中的正确opcode/params。
642: - 若要任意 descriptor echo，必须使用独立测试CP固件，不能写成“不修改CP”的正式门禁。
643: 
644: ### B2：完整raw HCI初始化
645: 
646: 继续使用raw selftest构建且不注册Host，按当前 `hci_initialize()` 顺序发送并检查
647: 真实status：
648: 
649: 1. vendor INIT。
650: 2. HCI Reset。
651: 3. Read Local Supported Features。
652: 4. Read Local Version Information。
653: 5. Read BD_ADDR。
654: 6. LE Read Local Supported Features。
655: 7. LE Read Buffer Size。
656: 8. Set Event Mask。
657: 9. LE Set Event Mask。
658: 10. Host Buffer Size。
659: 11. Set Controller To Host Flow Control。
660: 12. 若controller报告BR/EDR能力，再测 Read Buffer Size和LE Write Host Supported。
661: 
662: 每条命令记录 opcode、transport ACK、FREE、Command Complete/Status和status；不得用
663: ACK代替HCI成功。B2通过后关闭 `CONFIG_BK7258_BT_RAW_SELFTEST`、执行distclean，
664: 再进入B3正式Host构建。将 `LE Read Buffer Size` 返回的 ACL最大长度和数量写入本轮
665: 记录；它不是B0阶段可以静态假定的常量。
666: 
667: ### B3：注册NuttX Host
668: 
669: - `open()` 完成唯一 vendor INIT握手。
670: - Host完整初始化无timeout。
671: - `ifconfig` 可看到 `bnep0`。
672: - 注册结束时默认 advertising已经成功。
673: - `System.map` 包含 `bk7258_bt_*`、`bt_netdev_register`、`bt_initialize`。
674: 
675: ### B4：advertising和scan
676: 
677: 实板NSH基线：
678: 
679: ```sh
680: bt bnep0 info
681: bt bnep0 features le
682: bt bnep0 advertise stop
683: bt bnep0 advertise start
684: bt bnep0 scan start -d
685: bt bnep0 scan get
686: bt bnep0 scan stop
687: ```
688: 
689: 手机使用 nRF Connect或等价工具确认 `VelaSights` 可发现。advertising stop/start
690: 重复100次；scan start/get/stop重复100次，前后 heap和pool计数回到基线。
691: 
692: ### B5：连接和GATT fixture
693: 
694: 内置 `bt_services.c` 只有GAP name/appearance read，不足以验收write和notification。
695: 在 board目录增加最小测试service，具备：
696: 
697: - 一个 read/write characteristic。
698: - 一个 notify characteristic。
699: - CCC descriptor。
700: - CCC enable后由有界低频worker周期 notification；CCC disable或断连后立即停止。
701: 
702: 该service只在 `bt_driver_register()` 成功返回后注册，固定handle从 `0x0006` 或更高
703: 开始，不能与内置GAP service的 `0x0001..0x0005` 冲突。
704: 
705: 手机侧完成连接、service discovery、read、write、订阅CCC、notification、disconnect
706: 和reconnect。OpenVela作为client时使用：
707: 
708: ```sh
709: bt bnep0 gatt connect <addr> public
710: bt bnep0 gatt characteristic <addr> public
711: bt bnep0 gatt read <addr> public <handle>
712: bt bnep0 gatt write <addr> public <handle> <byte> [byte...]
713: bt bnep0 gatt disconnect <addr> public
714: ```
715: 
716: 地址类型按scan结果改为 `random`。验收同时检查双向ACL flow control和四类完成统计。
717: CP -> AP ACL被Host释放后，必须观察到 NuttX发送
718: `Host Number Of Completed Packets`；该项需要已建立连接，不属于B2初始化自检。
719: 
720: ### B6：稳定性、恢复和共存
721: 
722: - advertising/单连接运行72小时。
723: - connect/disconnect 1,000次。
724: - notification持续压力，queue/pool无净增长。
725: - Wi-Fi DHCP/TCP压力下 BLE不异常断开。
726: - BLE压力下 heartbeat、PWC、Mailbox UART无timeout。
727: - malformed/unknown/duplicate FREE全部拒绝且不破坏allocator。
728: - 无in-flight时 DEINIT/INIT 100次。
729: - 整机复位100次均重新出现 `bnep0` 和 advertising。

438:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)

446:       if (ret < 0)

452:     }

457:       if (ret < 0)

472:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
473:     {
474:       channel = &g_channels[i];
475:       if (!channel->queued)
476:         {
477:           continue;
478:         }
479: 
480:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
481:         {
482:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
483:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
484:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
485:             {
486:               active = &epoch->probe;
487:             }
488:           else
489:             {

491:             }

493:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&

498:         }
499:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
500:         {
501:           active = &g_active;

504:               return -ENOLINK;
505:             }
506:         }
507:       else

509:           return OK;
510:         }
511: 
512:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
513:         {
514:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
515:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,

517:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
518:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
519:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
520:             g_channel_ids[i]);
521:         }
522: 
523:       active->callback = channel->callback;
524:       active->arg = channel->arg;
525:       active->channel_index = i;
526:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
527:       active->busy = true;
528:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);

532:           return ret;
533:         }
534: 
535:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
536:         {
537:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
538:             {

540:             }

552: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
553:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
554:   const struct active_transaction *active)
555: {
556:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
557:   uint32_t reason = 0;
558: 
559:   if (!active->busy)
560:     {
561:       return 1u;
562:     }
563: 
564:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
565:     {
566:       reason |= 2u;
567:     }
568:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
569:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
570:     {
571:       reason |= 4u;
572:     }
573:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
574:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
575:     {
576:       reason |= 8u;
577:     }
578:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
579:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
580:     {
581:       reason |= 16u;
582:     }
583: 
584:   return reason;
585: }

597:   struct active_transaction *active;
598:   bool replay;
599:   int result;
600:   uint32_t reason;
601: 
602: 
603:   active = busy_probe();
604:   if (active == NULL)
605:     {
606:       active = &g_active;
607:     }
608: 
609:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
610:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
611:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
612:   if (reason != 0)
613:     {
614:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
615:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
616:       return;
617:     }
618: 
619: 
620:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
621:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
622:     {
623:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
624: 
625:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
626:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
627:       return;
628:     }
629: 
630:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
631:     {
632:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
633:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
634:       return;
635:     }
636: 
637:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
638:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
639: 
640:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
641:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
642:     {
643:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
644:     }
645: 
646:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
647:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
648:   if (replay)
649:     {
650:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
651:       unsigned int i;
652: 
653:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
654:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
655:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
656:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
657:        */
658: 
659:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
660:       g_active.quarantine = false;
661:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
662:         {
663:           if (i != replay_index)
664:             {
665:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
666:             }
667:         }
668: 
669:       select_recovery_epoch();
670:       (void)dispatch_locked();
671:       return;
672:     }
673: 
674:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
675: 
676:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
677:     {
678:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
679:         {
680:           release_recovery_slots();
681:           g_recovery_index = 0;
682:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
683:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
684:         }
685:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
686:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
687:         {
688:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
689:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
690:            */
691:         }
692:       else
693:         {
694:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
695:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
696:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
697:         }

699: 
700:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
701:            result < 0)
702:     {
703:       begin_abort(result);
704:     }

706:   (void)dispatch_locked();

709: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
710: {
711:   struct ack_slot *slot;
712:   unsigned int rx_index;
713:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
714:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
715:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
716:   uint8_t state = 0;
717:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
718: 
719:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
720: 
721:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
722:     {
723:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
724:       if (slot == NULL)
725:         {
726:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
727:           return -EAGAIN;
728:         }
729:     }
730:   else
731:     {
732:       slot = NULL;
733:     }
734: 
735:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
736:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
737:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
738:     {
739:       g_stats.bad_header++;
740:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
741:     }
742:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
743:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
744:     {
745:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
746:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
747:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
748:         {
749:           if (slot != NULL)
750:             {
751:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
752:             }
753: 
754:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
755:           return -EAGAIN;
756:         }
757:       else if (ret < 0)
758:         {
759:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
760:         }
761:     }
762:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
763:     {
764:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
765:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
766:         {
767:           if (slot != NULL)
768:             {
769:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
770:             }
771: 
772:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
773:           return -EAGAIN;
774:         }
775:       else if (ret < 0)
776:         {
777:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
778:         }
779:     }
780:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
781:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
782:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
783:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
784:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
785:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
786:     {
787:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
788:       ack_flags = 2u;
789:       ret = OK;
790:     }
791:   else
792:     {
793:       g_stats.unsupported++;
794:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
795:     }
796: 
797:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
798:     {
799:       return OK;
800:     }
801: 
802:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
803:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
804:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
805:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
806:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
807: 
808:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
809:     {
810:       g_probe_requested = true;
811:     }
812: 
813:   (void)dispatch_locked();
814:   return OK;
815: }

817: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
818: {
819:   irqstate_t flags;
820:   uint8_t control;
821: 
822:   flags = up_irq_save();
823:   g_stats.rx++;
824:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
825: 
826:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
827:     {
828:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
829:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
830:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)

833:         }

850:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)

852:           up_irq_restore(flags);
853:           return ret;
854:         }
855:     }
856: 
857:   up_irq_restore(flags);
858:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
859:   return OK;

126: 		C61/C60 (1uF) into MIC2P/MIC2N so that AEC can have a hardware echo
127: 		reference, and ana_reg27 does have a full micen field for MIC2.
128:

130: 		BK7258: measured on hardware, the ADC delivers a single channel and
131: 		the upper half of every AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT word stays zero. With a
132: 		tone audibly playing and MIC1 picking it up acoustically (RMS rising
133: 		from 25.7 to 36.4), MIC2 still returned exactly zero across 15872
134: 		samples. That matches the vendor HAL, where sys_hal_aud_mic2_en()
135: 		and sys_hal_aud_dacr_en() are both explicit "//not support" stubs
136: 		for this SoC: the register fields exist, the datapath does not.
137: 
138: 		Enabling this only costs half of every capture buffer to zeros. Use
139: 		a software AEC reference instead -- feed aec_proc() the same PCM
140: 		that was queued to the DAC, which is cleaner anyway (no analog
141: 		noise, no divider tolerance) and needs only a fixed delay
142: 		compensation for the DAC and amplifier.

150: 		8000, 16000 and 32000 are currently reachable: the driver runs the
151: 		audio block from the 26 MHz crystal, and the 44100/48000 families
152: 		additionally require the APLL calibration sequence, which has not
153: 		been ported yet.
154: 
155: config BK7258_AUDIO_PA_MUTE_GPIO
156: 	int "External amplifier mute GPIO"
157: 	default 50
158: 	depends on BK7258_AUDIO

160: 		BK7258 GPIO driving net MUTE, which reaches the HT6872 CTRL pin
161: 		through R70 (1K). R71 (10K) pulls it low, so the amplifier is muted
162: 		until software drives this pin high. Per the board schematic

180: 		header comment and its code disagree on where this delay sits; the

6: #include <stddef.h>

12:

14:

16: #include "bk7258_ramdisk.h"
17: #include "bk7258_gc9d01_fb.h"
18: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
19: #include "bk7258_wifi.h"
20: 
21: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_AUDIO
22: #  include "bk7258_audio_bringup.h"
23: #endif
24: 
25: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_JPEG_ENC
26: #  include "bk7258_jpeg_enc.h"
27: #endif
28: 
29: #define BK7258_LINK_WAIT_MS 8000u
30: 
31: int bk7258_pwc_start(void);
32: int bk7258_motor_setup(void);
33: int bk7258_power_key_motor_start(void);
34: int bk7258_gc9d01_test(int argc, char **argv);
35: int bk7258_camera_initialize(void);
36: 
37: int bk7258_bringup(void)
38: {
39:   uint32_t button_count;
40:   int ret;
41: 
42:   button_count = board_button_initialize();
43: #ifdef CONFIG_FS_PROCFS
44:   /* Mount procfs first so that ps, free and the other informational NSH
45:    * commands work even if a later bring-up step returns early. A mount
46:    * failure is reported but never blocks bring-up: procfs is not required
47:    * by the console data path.
48:    */
49: 
50:   ret = nx_mount(NULL, "/proc", "procfs", 0, NULL);
51:   if (ret < 0)
52:     {
53:       printf("failed to mount procfs at /proc, error=%d\n", ret);
54:     }
55: #endif
56: 
57:   ret = bk7258_motor_setup();
58:   if (ret < 0)
59:     {
60:       return ret;
61:     }
62: 
63:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready(BK7258_LINK_WAIT_MS);
64:   if (ret < 0)
65:     {
66:       printf("mailbox UART0 STATE probe failed, error=%d\n", ret);
67:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
68:       bk7258_mbox_uart_dump_stats();
69:       return ret;
70:     }
71: 
72:   printf("mailbox UART0 link ready\n");
73: 
74:   ret = bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_start();
75:   if (ret < 0)
76:     {
77:       printf("HW_CTRL power-up service failed, error=%d\n", ret);
78:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
79:       return ret;
80:     }
81: 
82:   ret = bk7258_pwc_start();
83:   if (ret < 0)
84:     {
85:       return ret;
86:     }
87: 
88: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI
89:   ret = bk7258_wifi_initialize();
90:   if (ret < 0)
91:     {
92:       return ret;
93:     }
94: #endif
95: 
96:   printf("button GPIOs configured, count=%lu\n",
97:          (unsigned long)button_count);
98:   printf("PWM device registered at /dev/pwm0\n");
99:   printf("mailbox transport, PWC and CPU1 ready handshake complete\n");
100:   printf("heartbeat worker started, interval=2000 ms\n");
101: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
102:   if (bk7258_psram_is_online())
103:     {
104:       printf("PSRAM online, base=0x60000000 size=0x01000000 "
105:              "RW/XN/non-cacheable\n");
106: 
107:       /* PSRAM-backed /dev/ram0: the only storage on this board big enough
108:        * to hold a captured frame as a file (tmpfs lives in the ~300KB
109:        * kernel heap, one 640x480 YUYV frame is 614400 bytes).
110:        */
111: 
112:       (void)bk7258_ramdisk_initialize();
113:       /* printf("PSRAM CP heap 0x60700000..0x6071ffff reserved\n"); */
114:       /* bk7258_psram_dump(); */
115:     }
116:   else
117:     {
118:       printf("PSRAM unavailable; media services must remain disabled\n");
119:     }
120: #endif
121: 
122:   ret = bk7258_power_key_motor_start();
123:   if (ret < 0)
124:     {
125:       return ret;
126:     }
127: 
128:   return 0;
129: }
130: 
131: void board_late_initialize(void)
132: {
133:   int ret = bk7258_bringup();
134: 
135:   if (ret < 0)
136:     {
137:       printf("board bring-up stopped, error=%d\n", ret);
138:       return;
139:     }
140: 
141:   printf("board bring-up initialization completed\n");
142: 
143:   /* GC9D01 QSPI panel bring-up smoke test.  board_app_finalinitialize()
144:    * (BOARDIOC_FINALINIT) is never invoked in this minimal, apps-less NSH
145:    * configuration (no CONFIG_BOARDCTL_FINALINIT, no apps/nshlib start-up
146:    * script caller), so the test entry point is invoked here instead, from
147:    * the unconditionally-called CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE hook.  See

1: #!/bin/bash
2: # autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
3: #
4: # How it works
5: # ------------
6: # bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
7: # but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
8: # either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
9: # bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
10: #
11: # The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
12: # reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
13: # about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
14: # and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
15: #
16: # bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
17: # into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
18: # the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
19: # scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
20: #
21: # IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
22: # corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
23: # appears in the log.
24: 
25: set -u
26: 
27: ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
28: LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
29: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
30: RUNTIME_DIR="$ROOT/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/runtime"
31: EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016
32: 
33: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
34: PORTNUM=0
35: 
36: # Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
37: #
38: # BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
39: # the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
40: # raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
41: # meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
42: # nothing typed into it worked.
43: BAUD=115200
44: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
45: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
46: LOG="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.log"
47: REBOOT_TRIES=8
48: REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5
49: 
50: # Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
51: #
52: # A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
53: # is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
54: # 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
55: # leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
56: # transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
57: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
58: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
59: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
60: TEST_ONLY=0
61:

64: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
65: 
66:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
67:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
68:   -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
69:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
70:   -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
71:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
72:   -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
73:   -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
74:   -h           显示本帮助
75: 
76: 说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
77:       同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。

82:   case "$opt" in
